title: NOT BLANK () is TRUE

source.quote: Changes FALSE to TRUE , or TRUE to FALSE .
BLANK or a blank value is converted to 0 , "" , or False , depending on the data type of the other compared value.
source.supports: as a boolean BLANK is FALSE

derivation: NOT needs a boolean; BLANK converts to FALSE, and NOT FALSE is TRUE.
alternative: The data types page lists BLANK OR BLANK and BLANK AND BLANK as BLANK, so logical operators can keep a BLANK. If NOT keeps it too, the result is BLANK.
